title: Submit the contact form successfully
description: This verifies that a visitor can send a valid inquiry through the contact form and receive a successful submission status.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the form
Verify a successful submission status is visible
Verify the contact form reflects that the message was sent

title: Jump between portfolio sections from the header
description: This test verifies that a visitor can use the header navigation to move from About to Experience to Contact and reach the expected sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the section link for About
Verify the About section is displayed
Click the section link for Experience
Verify the Experience section is displayed
Click the section link for Contact
Verify the Contact section is displayed

title: Use the contact shortcut to jump to the contact section
description: This test verifies that the Get In Touch action scrolls the visitor directly to the contact section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the Get In Touch action
Verify the Contact section is displayed

title: See the active section indicator and progress bar update while scrolling
description: This test verifies that scrolling through the page updates the active navigation state and the top progress indicator as the visitor moves between sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll the page to the About section
Verify the active navigation highlight reflects the current section
Scroll the page to the Experience section
Verify the top progress bar advances

title: Use hero actions to reach contact and clinical experience
description: This test verifies that the hero actions send the visitor to the contact section and the clinical experience section as intended.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select the Hire Me action
Verify the Contact section is displayed
Select the Explore action
Verify the clinical experience section is displayed

title: Show validation when a required contact field is missing
description: This verifies that the contact form prevents submission when a required field is left empty and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Submit the form
Verify a validation message is visible
Verify the form is not submitted

title: Open and dismiss the credentials modal
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the academic credentials modal, review the details, and close it to continue browsing.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the credentials modal
Verify the academic credentials modal is displayed
Close the credentials modal
Verify the academic credentials modal is not visible

title: Show validation for an invalid email address
description: This verifies that the contact form rejects an invalid email format and displays validation feedback before submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with an invalid email address
Fill in the message field with a valid message
Submit the form
Verify an email validation message is visible
Verify the message is not submitted

title: Review and close the Care24 rotation breakdown
description: This test verifies that the Care24 Medical Centre breakdown modal opens with rotation details and can be closed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the detailed breakdown for Care24 Medical Centre
Verify the clinical rotation modal is displayed
Close the clinical rotation modal
Verify the clinical rotation modal is not visible

title: Browse skill categories and compare capabilities
description: This verifies that a visitor can review the skills matrix, move between skill groups, and inspect the capabilities shown for each category.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the skills section
Hover over a skill badge in the biomedical category
Hover over a skill badge in the IoT category
Hover over a skill badge in the software category
Verify capabilities for multiple skill categories are displayed
Verify the skills section shows distinct biomedical, IoT, and software emphasis

title: Open and close the mobile navigation menu
description: This test verifies that a mobile visitor can open the navigation menu, jump to a section, and close the menu afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the mobile navigation menu
Select the section link for Skills
Verify the Skills section is displayed
Close the mobile navigation menu
Verify the mobile navigation menu is not visible

title: Review and dismiss the Maruthi rotation breakdown with Escape
description: This test verifies that the Maruthi Medical Centre breakdown modal can be opened and dismissed using the Escape key.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the detailed breakdown for Maruthi Medical Centre
Verify the clinical rotation modal is displayed
Press Escape
Verify the clinical rotation modal is not visible

title: Open an external social profile from the hero section
description: This test verifies that a social link in the hero section opens the corresponding external destination.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the LinkedIn social link
Verify the external profile destination is opened

title: Dismiss a clinical rotation modal by clicking outside it
description: This test verifies that clicking the backdrop closes an open clinical rotation modal.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the detailed breakdown for Care24 Medical Centre
Verify the clinical rotation modal is displayed
Click outside the modal content
Verify the clinical rotation modal is not visible

title: Review skill proficiency indicators across categories
description: This verifies that a visitor can inspect proficiency indicators and see consistent skill emphasis information while browsing the matrix.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the skills section
Hover over a proficiency indicator in the biomedical category
Hover over a proficiency indicator in the IoT category
Hover over a proficiency indicator in the software category
Verify proficiency details are displayed for the hovered skill items
Verify the skill emphasis remains visible while comparing categories

title: Open the email contact destination
description: This verifies that a visitor can use the direct email contact link from the contact section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Click the email contact link
Verify the email destination opens
Verify the contact section remains accessible after opening the link

description: This verifies that a visitor can use the direct WhatsApp contact link from the contact section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Click the WhatsApp contact link
Verify the WhatsApp destination opens
Verify the contact section remains accessible after opening the link

title: View contact location information
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the location details from the contact section and see the location information.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the contact section
Click the location details link
Verify the location information is displayed
Verify the contact section still shows the available contact options
